title: typeof null is a famous lie
why_it_matters: typeof is a handy check, but it has two traps.
explanation: typeof returns a value's type as text. It works for strings, numbers and booleans, but typeof null says 'object', an old mistake that can't be fixed. Arrays also say 'object'. Check null with === null, and arrays with Array.isArray.
code:
console.log(typeof "hi");       // string
console.log(typeof 42);         // number
console.log(typeof null);       // object
console.log(typeof []);         // object
console.log(Array.isArray([])); // true
try_it: Quiz: what is typeof undefined? And typeof a function? Check in the console.
